description: The instant on-demand atomic CSS engine.

latest_release.name: v66.12.0
latest_release.body:
###    🚀 Features

- **preset-wind4**:
  - Add scrollbar width and color utilities  -  by @anandghegde, **Claude Code** and @zyyv in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5343 [<samp>(55375)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/5537531b7)
  - Support parentheses syntax for css variables  -  by @hexlabelposition in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5392 [<samp>(844eb)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/844eb540e)

###    🐞 Bug Fixes

- **build**:
  - Align local pnpm with package manager version  -  by @hannoeru in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5396 [<samp>(00f76)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/00f76d767)
- **core**:
  - Make rule sorting independent of token order  -  by @Timeraa in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5383 [<samp>(57c07)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/57c07b129)
- **eslint-plugin**:
  - Support helper calls and function slots in order rule  -  by @praburangki in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5318 [<samp>(2e98d)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/2e98d145a)
  - Sort utilities in `un-` prefixed attributes with `order`  -  by @zaderlyl and @zyyv in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5381 [<samp>(7224d)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/7224d8444)
- **inspector**:
  - Inline `getCSS` from lsp  -  by @Jungzl in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5382 [<samp>(eeaee)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/eeaeef2e9)
- **preset-attributify**:
  - Apply ignoreAttributes after stripping binding prefixes  -  by @rajanpanth in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5306 [<samp>(7bceb)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/7bcebfd60)
- **preset-wind4**:
  - Support container sizes in `basis-*`  -  by @AliBaig-xD in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5386 [<samp>(92703)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/9270320db)
  - Don't wrap arbitrary CSS variable colors in color-mix()  -  by @hermanrous and @zyyv in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5380 [<samp>(c58cd)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/c58cd4ec7)
- **vite**:
  - Resolve `uno.css` entry in `dist-chunk` build mode  -  by @x-labb in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5388 [<samp>(59bc2)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/59bc22c71)
  - Styles missing or duplicated when mode is `vue-scoped`  -  by @Jungzl and @zyyv in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/4829 [<samp>(e0c82)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/e0c82afed)
  - Support virtual:uno.css?inline in production builds  -  by @00200200 and **Han** in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5362 [<samp>(4e357)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/4e3574df6)
- **webpack**:
  - Refactor virtual CSS loading to use structured filter and handler  -  by @zyyv [<samp>(2d15b)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/2d15b2a95)

###    🏎 Performance

- **core**:
  - Avoid intermediate arrays in token cache queries  -  by @hannoeru in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5393 [<samp>(60bf3)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/60bf342a6)
  - Build dynamic rule order with one reverse  -  by @hannoeru in https://github.com/unocss/unocss/issues/5394 [<samp>(04e6b)</samp>](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/commit/04e6b0321)

#####     [View changes on GitHub](https://github.com/unocss/unocss/compare/v66.11.0...v66.12.0)
